summary.name: Placeit
summary.one_liner: Placeit is an online design platform with templates for product mockups, logos, videos, and other marketing designs.
use_cases: Creating product mockups for Etsy or Amazon listings
Making print-on-demand apparel photos for Printify shops
Designing a logo for a business
Branding a Twitch stream or YouTube channel
summary.what_it_does: The page advertises a library of over 150,000 templates for logos, mockups, videos, flyers, and business cards. Mockups show apparel such as t-shirts, hoodies, sweatshirts, crewnecks, and tote bags, plus mugs, with customizable backgrounds. Users drag and drop their own designs onto the mockup templates to produce product shots. It also offers gaming and streaming branding templates for Twitch and YouTube and premade logo templates across industries. The page says a free tier exists with some free templates, and that the annual plan includes unlimited downloads with no credits.
notable: Drag-and-drop design onto product mockup templates for apparel and mugs
Templates for Twitch and YouTube channel branding
Advertised as unlimited downloads with no credits on annual plan
caveats: Best offer requires an annual plan; the first-year discount is only for annual plans and the offer has an end date
Some free templates are offered, but full access appears to be behind a paid plan
